statement:
open KdVPlan in ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff,
 MemH (m:ℝ) f → MemH (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k) →
 HB ((m:ℝ)+1) f (hn (m:ℝ) f+hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))
proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro m f hf hd
  refine ⟨(@yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m f).mp ⟨hf,hd⟩,?_⟩
  have he : (fun k : ℤ=>weight ((m:ℝ)+1) k*‖f k‖^2)=(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2)+(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖(k:ℂ)*f k‖^2) := by
    funext k
    simp only [weight,Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1+(k:ℝ)^2),Real.rpow_one,norm_mul,mul_pow,Pi.add_apply]
    have hn : ‖(k:ℂ)‖^2=(k:ℝ)^2 := by simp [Complex.norm_intCast,sq_abs]
    rw [hn]
    ring
  have hs : ∀ (s : ℝ) (g : Coeff), (hn s g)^2=∑' k, weight s k*‖g k‖^2:=by
    intro s g
    exact @yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ (fun k=>mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have heq : (hn ((m:ℝ)+1) f)^2=(hn (m:ℝ) f)^2+(hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))^2:=by
    rw [hs,hs,hs,he]
    exact hf.tsum_add hd
  have h1:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 f
  have h2:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k)
  have h3:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 ((m:ℝ)+1)).1 f
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 h2])
